explanation: Zero at every GO and D2 step and at every step before about trial 90; it fires only at D1 in the last ~10 trials of the episode, when the agent has kept choosing a1 and reaching S1 by common transitions, whether or not those trials paid. It builds over that streak, about 5 on the first such trial, then 8-9, then 10 from the third trial on, and falls back to 0 (or about 2-3) on the D1 after a rare transition, a choice of a2 or a reversal.
